status: Logical design only; no migration or running database

User.constraints: Partial UNIQUE(emailNormalized) WHERE NOT NULL; canonical account; provider identities are separate UserIdentity rows; never merge on email alone

UserIdentity.constraints: UNIQUE(issuer,subject); UNIQUE(userId,issuer); proof-based linking only; issuer+subject is stable identity, not email

Role.constraints: System roles immutable keys; permission grants versioned

UserRole.constraints: No self-grant; scope granted separately; privileged grant requires step-up

Session.constraints: Opaque random token hashed at rest; tokens never in analytics; check user status and authorizationVersion every request

Device.constraints: Binding cookie is a risk signal, not proof of identity or location

AdminScope.constraints: Exactly one referenced scope level; consistent ancestry; higher-scope grantor; no self-scope modification

AdminInvitation.constraints: Single-use; authorized approver; public registration cannot create admin

MfaEnrollment.constraints: Secrets and recovery credentials held by identity provider encrypted; no plaintext mirror in business DB

StepUpChallenge.constraints: Binds approval to actor, session, exact action and payload hash; one use

ConsentRecord.constraints: Append-only consent history; no prechecked marketing/personalization consent

PrivacyRequest.constraints: Export/delete with legal-hold exceptions; propagate to search, AI profile and caches

Country.constraints: BD first; US configured but disabled; currency immutable after financial activity

CountryConfiguration.constraints: UNIQUE(countryId,version); crossBorderEnabled default false; activation requires legal gate

City.constraints: UNIQUE(districtId,code); city/upazila are siblings, not ancestor/descendant

ServiceZone.constraints: UNIQUE(cityId,code); overlapping active coverage requires explicit deterministic resolution

BoundaryVersion.constraints: UNIQUE(ownerType,ownerId,version); ST_IsValid; immutable after approval; GiST boundary; no geometry in client write authority

Address.constraints: Exactly one customer, vendor or rider owner; store address vendor must match; ancestry checked; coordinates revalidated against active polygon at quote/checkout; customer address-book owner isolated

Customer.constraints: No compulsory retail KYC; profile deletion does not erase legally retained financial records

Vendor.constraints: Activation requires current KYC and authorized approval; one legal vendor can have multiple stores

VendorMembership.constraints: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT(vendorId,userId,storeId); store staff limited to store; owner cannot read another vendor

Store.constraints: Address and city ancestry match; pickup point verified; active KYC required

VendorServiceArea.constraints: UNIQUE(storeId,serviceZoneId); destination eligibility; same-country only initially

Rider.constraints: Capacity default 1 active delivery; current KYC and vehicle eligibility required

RiderServiceArea.constraints: UNIQUE active grant; overrides audited and time-limited

Vehicle.constraints: Motor vehicles require applicable license/registration; bicycle does not

RiderShift.constraints: At most one open shift per rider; end shift blocked from new offers but active delivery finishes safely

RiderLocation.constraints: Append-only; GiST(riderId,recordedAt); active consent/shift required; raw retention proposed <=30 days

PayoutDestination.constraints: Never exposed in full to ordinary admin; ownership proof + verification; change triggers payout cooldown/step-up
PayoutDestination.x-implementation-reference: Implemented vendor-specific encrypted destination/review subset: docs/41-vendor-payout-destinations.md. Generic proposed owner model is not an executable schema.

KYCCase.constraints: One open case per subject/version; status separate from account suspension; no self approval

VendorKYC.constraints: Individual/company conditional document policy; payout destination verified separately

RiderKYC.constraints: Motor-vehicle conditional requirements; no unnecessary biometrics

AdminKYC.constraints: Super Admin approval; bootstrap superadmins use offline two-person ceremony

KYCDocument.constraints: Private quarantine bucket; object not publicly readable; document checksum and expiry; consent required

KYCReview.constraints: Append-only; reviewer cannot be subject/uploader for same approval; source and evidence recorded

Category.constraints: No category cycles; regulated goods feature-gated

Product.constraints: Vendor ownership enforced; publication requires approved vendor and product moderation

ProductVariant.constraints: UNIQUE(productId,sku); vendor-wide SKU policy enforced in command if required; nonnegative integer minor units; price history audited

ProductImage.constraints: Moderated media; no SVG/active content; approved CDN public product assets only

InventoryReservation.constraints: Positive quantity; idempotent checkout reservation; expiry releases stock; no negative inventory

Cart.constraints: Exactly one owner kind; merge only after authenticated ownership proof; never trust client totals

CheckoutQuote.constraints: Server computed; country equality; expiry; binding quote hash; buyer GPS not a destination filter

OrderRecipient.constraints: Separate from buyer; restricted contact fields; snapshot survives address-book edits

Order.constraints: UNIQUE(buyerId,idempotencyKey); total equation; same buyer/recipient country initially; parent aggregates suborders

VendorSuborder.constraints: UNIQUE(orderId,vendorId,storeId); manual ready transition; vendors read only their own suborders

OrderItem.constraints: Quantity >0; immutable price/title/sku snapshot; partial cancellation by quantity

OrderStatusEvent.constraints: Exactly one order or suborder reference; append-only transition history; valid state machine enforced in service

Delivery.constraints: UNIQUE(suborderId,attemptNumber); one current nonterminal delivery per suborder by partial unique index; replacement preserves prior attempts; completion requires proof and COD accounting

DeliveryRouteSnapshot.constraints: Road-route evidence; no silent straight-line fallback; earnings route is store-to-recipient

RiderRateRule.constraints: No overlapping active versions for same scope/effective interval; future edits immutable version; approved scope precedence

RiderRateSlab.constraints: Lower inclusive, upper exclusive; no gaps/overlaps within rule; last upper nullable only with approved policy

RiderRateSnapshot.constraints: One snapshot per accepted assignment; captured atomically on final rider acceptance by default; later rate/route changes do not rewrite history

RiderAssignment.constraints: Partial UNIQUE(deliveryId) WHERE releasedAt IS NULL; rider capacity checked under lock; manual mode requires authorized actor/reason and same eligibility

DeliveryOffer.constraints: UNIQUE(deliveryId,attempt); partial UNIQUE(deliveryId) WHERE status=OFFERED; 30-second database-time expiry

DeliveryProof.constraints: Hash OTP with server pepper; short TTL and attempt cap; rider submits but cannot mint/read code; only designated recipient receives code; fallback separately authorized

DeliveryException.constraints: Append-only decision history via audit; OTP fallback/failed delivery/return requires authorized review; never silently marks delivered

CODCollection.constraints: Cash collection is a liability, not rider earnings; discrepancy creates review case

CODDeposit.constraints: Unverified deposit never reduces due balance; unique verified external reference; no screenshot-only confirmation

CODAllocation.constraints: Verified deposit allocations cannot exceed deposit or collection outstanding; append-only reversal links

PaymentProviderAccount.constraints: No credentials in frontend; live disabled until contract/capability/security gates

PaymentEvent.constraints: UNIQUE(providerAccountId,providerEventKey); raw sensitive data minimized; replay safe

Refund.constraints: Approved amount <= refundable balance; COD refund destination verified; provider acceptance is not completion

Chargeback.constraints: UNIQUE(paymentId,providerCaseReference); ledger reversal not payment-row overwrite

CommissionRule.constraints: Explicit precedence and overlap validation; default product subtotal excludes delivery; percent 0..10000

CommissionSnapshot.constraints: UNIQUE(suborderId,policy); historical rule immutable; partial refund prorates by approved policy

LedgerAccount.constraints: Separate vendor receivable, rider earnings, COD custody, clearing, payout reserve and platform accounts

JournalEntry.constraints: Append-only; all lines and accounts match journal currency; business event unique; corrections via reversal

LedgerLine.constraints: UNIQUE(journalId,lineNumber); amount >0; deferred constraint SUM(debits)=SUM(credits); no UPDATE/DELETE

LedgerBalanceSnapshot.constraints: Rebuildable projection, not source of truth; reconcile to immutable lines

Payout.constraints: UNIQUE(riderId,periodStart,periodEnd,scheduleKey); business payout stable across attempts; reserve before send; unknown result reconciles same attempt

PayoutItem.constraints: UNIQUE(deliveryId) and UNIQUE(earningJournalId); earning allocated once; failed attempt does not allocate it again; transparent COD adjustment journal if policy permits

Settlement.constraints: Net equation; verified destination; maker-checker; no double settlement; direct acquirer settlement reconciled separately
Settlement.x-implementation-reference: Implemented calculation/maker-checker payable-reservation subset: VendorSettlement/VendorSettlementItem, docs/42-vendor-settlement-review.md. Proposed period/provider-execution fields are not implemented; approval never moves money.
Settlement.x-sandbox-operations-reference: docs/43-sandbox-finance-operations.md: TEST_ONLY refund/adjustment journals, statement reconciliation and payout reservation/submission/completion; no live transfer.

SettlementItem.constraints: UNIQUE(suborderId); initial release settles each eligible suborder once; later adjustments use reversals; failed transfer retries same settlement
SettlementItem.x-implementation-reference: Implemented as append-only VendorSettlementItem with per-suborder policy snapshot and integer arithmetic; docs/42-vendor-settlement-review.md.

ReconciliationRecord.constraints: Daily provider/bank/COD/ledger checks; unmatched/unknown items escalated

FraudCase.constraints: Score 0..100; VPN alone insufficient for rejection; evidence preserved separately

FraudEvidence.constraints: Least-data evidence; no covert communications or device scraping

FraudDecision.constraints: Append-only; reject confirmed fraud requires evidence and authorized policy/human review

ReturnRequest.constraints: Only eligible order items; vendor sees own request; return and refund states separate

Review.constraints: Rating 1..5; verified purchase derived server-side; moderation audit

SupportTicket.constraints: Scope by associated resource; private attachments; SOS uses dedicated safety workflow

SupportMessage.constraints: Participants and authorized support only; immutable edit history

ProductInteraction.constraints: First-party only; indexed owner/time; proposed raw TTL 180 days; clear derived interests on deletion

PersonalizationProfile.constraints: Can opt out/clear; no raw cross-app audio; vendors get aggregates only

AIInvocation.constraints: Scoped read-only tools by default; sensitive execution prohibited; log denials and human approval

AIApproval.constraints: Human approval bound to exact action; no AI self-approval; execute via normal domain service

Notification.constraints: Recipient scoped; preferences and consent honored; security alerts separate lawful basis

NotificationPreference.constraints: UNIQUE(userId,channel,purpose); marketing opt-in separate from service messages

AuditLog.constraints: Append-only; restricted read; no passwords/OTPs/tokens; include sensitive reads/exports/denials

OutboxEvent.constraints: Written in same transaction as domain change; at-least-once delivery; consumers idempotent

IdempotencyRecord.constraints: UNIQUE(actorId,route,key); same key/different payload =>409; finance retention follows linked records

FeatureFlag.constraints: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT(key,countryId,environment); default false for unfinished/payment/cross-border/AI features

VendorPlan.constraints: No historical plan mutation; prices are business configuration, not hardcoded

VendorSubscription.constraints: First-year free offer if approved; explicit start/end and renewal notice; no silent backdated charge

Coupon.constraints: Server validates scope/eligibility; redemption lock prevents overuse

Campaign.constraints: Claims such as free shipping require actual eligibility; consent-based targeting

NewsletterSubscription.constraints: Double opt-in proposed; unsubscribe single use signed token

LoyaltyAccount.constraints: Feature-flagged; points/cashback financial liability tracked through ledger where redeemable

LoyaltyEvent.constraints: Append-only; expiry/reversal explicit; no duplicate campaign awards

Referral.constraints: Anti-self-referral; reward only after configured qualifying event

PayoutAttempt.constraints: UNIQUE(payoutId,attemptNumber); unknown result stays reserved; definitive failure releases via reversal before a new attempt

SettlementAttempt.constraints: UNIQUE(settlementId,attemptNumber); retries never duplicate settlement items
